Headquarters: Toronto
 
URL: https://www.poweredbysearch.com/

Ready to own paid media strategy for some of the fastest-growing B2B companies?

If you can run a Google Ads account (LinkedIn and Meta, too) with precision, and guide conversations with conviction, composure and confidence, we want to talk to you.

We're looking for a Paid Media Strategist who can lead senior client conversations, turn campaign complexity into clear business recommendations, and confidently explain what matters, why it matters, and what should happen next.

Our mission at Powered by Search

We exist to make B2B companies unstoppable, doing work we love, with people we like, how we want. We are a global, fully remote team across 8+ countries.

We have a talented and diverse team that live by our core values:

• Always be in it to win it.

• Give a shit.

• Be obsessed with serving others.

• Practice a growth mindset.

• When we fail, don’t lose the lesson.

The opportunity

As a trusted advisor to fast-growing B2B companies, you'll join a high performing team rated 4.8/5 on Glassdoor, where 95% of team members recommend us. This is a client-facing strategic paid media role. You won't just build campaigns or ship reports. You will lead calls, set the agenda, guide clients toward decisions, and connect every dollar of spend to pipeline and revenue.
What sets you apart

• You lead senior client conversations with clarity, confidence, and commercial judgment

• You keep control of a call: set the agenda, handle pushback thoughtfully in the moment, land on decisions and next steps

• You report on the metrics the client's business runs on (demos, pipeline, revenue), never vanity metrics

• You translate campaign data into plain-language recommendations a CMO can act on

• You come to every conversation with a recommendation, not just a list of options

• You spot risks, opportunities, and blockers before the client has to ask

• You can deliver honest, sometimes difficult feedback in a way clients trust

• You respectfully coach up and teach clients at multiple levels, from Marketing Managers to CMOs

Key responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

• Develop paid media strategies aligned to each client's business goals and North Star Metric

• Own forecasting and budget pacing against quarterly and annual targets

• Lead monthly and quarterly reviews with senior stakeholders: results, tradeoffs, risks, next actions

• Steer client conversations toward decisions, priorities, and committed next steps

• Drive AI-assisted campaign strategy, creative testing, and measurement

Client Success

• Manage and grow a portfolio of 4-7 B2B clients as their primary strategic contact

• Build trust with senior marketing, demand gen, and executive stakeholders

• Run calls with confidence: set agendas, control the room, handle hard questions live

• Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations before the client asks

• Own follow-through so every conversation ends with clear actions, owners, and timelines

Technical Excellence

• Plan, launch, and optimize across Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn, and Meta Ads

• Own conversion tracking integrity end to end (GA4, GTM, CRM); never launch without it

• Diagnose performance issues at the root: tracking, structure, bidding, creative, or demand

• Prioritize by business impact, effort, and implementation reality; QA everything before it ships

Required experience

• 3+ years hands-on B2B paid media, with at least 1 year in B2B SaaS

• Prior client-facing strategy role where you owned communication, not just execution

• Track record hitting MQL, SQL, or pipeline targets for B2B clients

• Direct responsibility for at least $50k in monthly ad spend across multiple accounts

• Google Ads depth plus at least one of LinkedIn, Meta, or Microsoft Ads

• Working command of GA4, GTM, and CRM attribution (HubSpot, Salesforce)

• Written and spoken communication skills strong enough to lead senior calls and defend recommendations under pressure

Perks & Benefits:

• This role is fully remote

• 5 weeks of paid time off

• We offer competitive compensation plus quarterly bonuses

• Flexible working hours (requires 4 overlap hours with 9am - 5pm EST)

• Paid training (school, events, conferences)

• *For full-time Canadian residents only - comprehensive health, dental, and eye care

This role may not be a fit if

• You prefer optimizing accounts without leading the client relationship

• You need someone else to turn your analysis into client-ready recommendations

• You lose the thread when a senior stakeholder challenges your numbers on a live call

• You report platform metrics (CTR, CPC, impressions) as results rather than business outcomes

• You prefer being handed tasks rather than owning outcomes, priorities, and follow-through

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/powered-by-search-senior-performance-marketing-strategist

Job Summary

Provide complex financial and business related analysis and research for financial and expense performance, rate of return, depreciation, working capital, and investment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

• Prepare forecasts and analyze trends in sales, finance, and general business conditions. 
• Provide summaries and analysis of special studies conducted and prepares recommendations for management to implement policies and guidelines to improve Jabil’s financial position. 
• Analyze present and future financial performance of company. 
• Compute and prepare data for journal entries, reviews general ledger and related financial statements for reasonableness. 
• Accumulate and analyze information for the preparation of financial statements, ledgers, reports and taxes. 
• Prepare financial reports for internal and external customers. 
• Coordinate with other departments in preparation of special analysis and reports. 
• Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. 
• Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy. 
• May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned. 

Job Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. 
• Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
• Ability to operate a personal computer including using a Windows based operating system and related software. 
• Advanced PC skills, including training and knowledge of Jabil’s software packages. 
• Ability to write simple correspondence. Read and understand visual aid. 
• Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out simple one- or two-step instructions. 
• Ability to deal with standardized situations with only occasional or no variables. 
• Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. 
• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. 
• Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret graphs. 

, BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.

The HR Shared Services Compensation operations senior associate combines analytical rigour with a service-orientated mindset. They will be comfortable working in the details of HR systems and cases while also understanding the broader impact of compensation data and decisions on employees, managers, payroll, reporting, and business operations.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will play a vital role in processing the backend transactions related to general compensation questions or tasks, along with making sure that the relevant SLA’s are met
  • Review and process requests related to job architecture, job codes, career levels, compensation tiers, pay ranges, compa-ratio, salary positioning, bonus eligibility, and other compensation-related fields in the HRIS
  • Pull ad hoc compensation reports, review data for accuracy and completeness, and help summarize basic findings for the compensation team and business partners
  • Assist with program documentation, supporting records, data integrity, audit readiness, and compliance materials
  • Partner with Compensation, HR Business Partners, Recruiting, Payroll, HRIS, Finance, and regional People Teams to investigate issues, resolve discrepancies, and coordinate end-to-end completion of transactions
  • Adhere to and demonstrate high proficiency in agreed critical metrics & SLAs
  • Create, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, checklists, process maps, and case-handling guidance for compensation processes
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality-control checks across SuccessFactors, case-management tools, payroll inputs, compensation planning files, and downstream reporting systems

Expected Skills

  • Experience for 4+ years in HR Operations / Shared Services in an HR Shared Services role (EMEA and Americas)
  • Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills, including data validation, lookups, filters, pivot tables, reconciliation, and basic analysis
  • A continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify patterns, diagnose process issues, and translate observations into practical improvements
  • Can function independently, with minimal mentorship and supervision
  • Working knowledge of compensation concepts, including salary ranges, market positioning, comp ratio, job architecture, pay changes, promotions, merit, bonus, and compensation data governance
  • Should be proficient with HRMS and ticketing tools such as Zendesk, SuccessFactors, and should have been excellent in meeting HRSS performance parameters - case handling, etc
